message: 堪えきれぬもの

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-saaaan!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's eat lunch together!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa, huge leap forward from asking a question!!」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I refuse!」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't need... anything like that!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There's no need to hold back. After all, I made suuuure to prepare seconds too!」

name: Azel
message: 「That's not the issue!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte went out of her way to make this for you, Azel.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's not right. The president and I made it together.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What!? When did that happen!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan's in a pinch!」

name: Azel
message: 「For... my sake...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come now, let's dig in!」
Lolotte spread the bento boxes out in front of Azel.
It was a splendid curry bento, simmered rich with spices by the name of love and effort.

name: Azel
message: 「S-Stop it...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san...?」

name: Azel
message: 「I said I don't want it!!」
Azel slapped away the hand of goodwill.
It was a completely unexpected movement. Unable to withstand the force, Lolotte dropped the bento she was holding--
Spilling it everywhere.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa, this is bad! Sacchin, grab something to wipe it up!\s01」

name: Sacchin
message: 「O-Okay!」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Azel...」

name: Azel
message: 「Tch... Now you see, don't you? Bothering with me is--」
Normally.
Lolotte would have burst out bawling, making her sadness blatantly obvious.
However, standing rooted in front of me, she was clearly different from her usual self.
As if holding something back.
And yet--

name: Lolotte
message: 「...Hic, ugh... *sniff*...」
She couldn't hold back the overflowing tears.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ngh... *sniff*. ...*snivel*, hic...」
Even so, she tried to suppress them again.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...」

name: Azel
message: 「If you want to blame me, go ahead and blame me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte wouldn't blame you for something like that anymore.」
She probably thought that if she gave in to her emotions right here and now, she wouldn't be able to step into the sanctuary that was Azel.
If she endured it, everything would be fine. They could go back to their usual relationship.
That way, it wouldn't turn into a fight. She held close to her heart that important lesson she had learned from her fight with Amyrina.
That's why she must have wanted to endure it desperately and smile, saying, 'I don't mind at all.'
Otherwise, she wouldn't be biting her lip so hard.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ngh... ugh... hic, *sniff*... hic」
Seeing Lolotte unable to form words, an unusual look of panic surfaced on Azel's face.

name: Synn
message: 「W-What's wrong?」

name: Azel
message: 「S-Shut up! As if I would be swayed by such emotions--」
And then, perhaps feeling uncomfortable, Azel bolted out of the classroom as if fleeing.
Lolotte stood stiffly, sniffling and trembling slightly.
Timing it right after Azel left, I pulled Lolotte into my chest.
And then, I gently stroked her head.

name: Synn
message: 「It's okay now. You don't have to hold it in.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ngh, ugh... uwaa--」
Triggered by those words, she raised her voice and wailed loudly.
